notes.title: TimeParadox Now Supports Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes: We’re excited to announce that TimeParadox now fully supports Simplified Chinese! It will automatically adjust the language depending on the system language.

notes.title: TimeParadox Now Supports Simplified Chinese
notes.notes:
Greetings, Universe Explorer! 

We’re thrilled to bring Simplified Chinese support to TimeParadox, allowing more players to experience its deep strategy and cosmic adventure in their native language. This update ensures that all in-game text, interface, and descriptions are now fully localized. [b]Support for other languages will be available soon[/b].

Best,
WOYMMM
